sources.title: Announcing the Open Source Release of the ERNIE 4.5 Model Family
sources.evidence: Dated June 30, 2025. Announces the ten released ERNIE 4.5 variants under Apache 2.0 and explicitly discusses ERNIE-4.5-VL-424B-A47B in thinking and non-thinking modes.

sources.title: ERNIE-4.5-VL-424B-A47B official model card
sources.evidence: Read through raw file after the rendered page returned 429. PT means Transformer-style PyTorch weights. This is the post-trained chat model derived from the separate Base model. Reports 424B total, 47B activated per token, 54 layers, 64/8 query/KV heads, 64/8 total/active experts for each modality, 131072 context, and Apache 2.0.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: 54 layers, hidden size 8192, untied 103424-token embedding/head, three initial dense layers followed by 51 MoE layers, 64 text and 64 vision experts with respective intermediate widths 3584 and 1536, top-8 routing, 32-layer 1280-wide vision encoder, and max_position_embeddings 131072.

sources.title: Complete checkpoint index and referenced safetensors headers
sources.evidence: Fetched only HTTP byte-range headers of all 172 indexed weight shards. All 20,475 indexed tensors were covered exactly once. Products of tensor shapes sum to 423,526,285,184 parameters: BF16 422,842,368,000; F32 53,483,904; F16 630,433,280. No packed quantized tensors, quantization-scale buffers, or MTP tensors occur. This is a shape count, not total_size divided by an assumed byte width.

sources.title: Official PyTorch model implementation
sources.evidence: Separates text and vision expert banks and routing. Defines e_score_correction_bias as a saved Parameter with requires_grad=False and uses it in top-k selection. The checkpoint contains no shared-expert tensors; its shared components are attention, initial dense FFNs, norms, embedding, and output head.

sources.title: Training update for routing correction biases
sources.evidence: on_optimizer_end computes a signed usage-balancing update and adds it to e_score_correction_bias outside gradient descent. The 6,528 saved routing-bias values are learned routing state and remain included; requires_grad=False alone is not grounds for excluding them.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint chat template
sources.evidence: Handles text, image/image_url, and video/video_url content and emits text. Implements enable_thinking with think delimiters. Supports system/user/assistant messages but contains no tools schema or tool-role serialization.

sources.title: AI Studio large-model API: model and feature support
sources.evidence: Official API page maps ERNIE-4.5-VL-424B-A47B to ernie-4.5-turbo-vl and lists text/image/video and deep thinking. Separately labels 128K context and 123K maximum input. Its tools documentation restricts use to the function-call support list, which excludes this mapped model.

sources.title: Qianfan model release history
sources.evidence: Raw page's June 2025 table dates ERNIE-4.5-Turbo-VL-Preview to June 29. That row does not identify a 424B-A47B checkpoint or immutable revision, so it cannot independently date this exact variant.

sources.title: ERNIE open-model availability announcement
sources.evidence: Updated July 18, 2025. Maps ERNIE-4.5-VL-424B-A47B to ernie-4.5-turbo-vl-preview. This later mapping does not establish that the June 29 rolling endpoint already served this exact checkpoint; it also shows thinking was not yet exposed on that endpoint.

sources.title: Baidu's March 16, 2025 ERNIE 4.5 and X1 announcement
sources.evidence: Announces a hosted native-multimodal ERNIE 4.5 and names heterogeneous multimodal MoE technology, but does not name the 424B-A47B variant or identify its checkpoint. Its broader audio claims and X1 tool-use claims cannot be transferred to this June checkpoint.

sources.title: ERNIE4.5 API now live on NovitaAI
sources.evidence: The provider June29,2025 launch article states ERNIE4.5 is now available and explicitly lists and links the exact baidu/ernie-4.5-vl-424b-a47b model. This gives exact-name hosted availability before the June30 Baidu weight announcement, without relying on a later rolling-endpoint alias mapping.

name.note: Official model name; removes the trailing space and uses the developer's spelling. PT denotes serialization framework, not pretraining.

family.note: Member of the ERNIE 4.5 family; preserves the catalog's family key.

release_date.note: Earliest documented exact-name hosted release: Novita June29 article explicitly lists this model as available. Baidu announced named open weights June30. Earlier family/rolling-alias dates do not prove this exact variant and are not substituted.

open_weights.note: Baidu publicly distributes the complete post-trained checkpoint.

license.note: Explicit model-weight license in the official card and release announcement.

parameters_b.note: Complete checkpoint shape count, versus the nominal 424B label. Exact decomposition in billions: shared attention/dense FFNs/norms/embedding/head 11.963047936; text routed experts 287.494373376; vision routed experts 123.211874304; text routers 0.026738688; vision routers 0.026738688; learned routing corrections 0.000006528; vision encoder 0.630433280; vision adapter 0.173072384. Sum 423.526285184. Includes all language and visual components and both untied embedding/head matrices. No shared experts or MTP tensors are stored. No quantization buffers were counted.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal activated-parameter figure, not an exact universal count. Text and vision tokens each select 8 of their own 64 experts, but those banks have different widths. The card does not define the embedding, visual-encoder/adapter, or modality/phase accounting convention. For example, counting both full embedding matrices and the shared decoder with 8 text experts produces 47.926586560B, so it must not be presented as the source's exact 47B definition. No unsupported exact phase count is substituted.

architecture.note: Heterogeneous vision-language Transformer MoE with modality-isolated text/vision routing. 54 decoder layers, of which 51 contain routed experts; a separate vision encoder and adapter are included in the total.

context_window.note: Exact model-card context and max_position_embeddings. The baseline 123000 reflects a hosted input allowance; the primary API documentation distinguishes 123K maximum input from 128K context.

modalities.note: Exact template and official mapped API support image, text, and video inputs, with text output. No audio capability is inherited from the March hosted model.

reasoning.note: Post-trained checkpoint explicitly supports thinking and non-thinking modes, including an enable_thinking template switch. Early hosted endpoint restrictions do not remove the released checkpoint's capability.

tool_call.note: Baidu excludes the mapped endpoint from its documented function-call support list and the released template lacks native tools formatting. This establishes the documented service limitation, but omission does not establish a universal absence of model capability. Exact-checkpoint native tool calling remains unverified; do not infer false from the unsupported interface.

description.value: Post-trained vision-language MoE chat model with text, image, and video inputs, text output, and thinking and non-thinking modes.
description.note: Replaces unsupported planning and tool-use marketing language with the documented exact-variant capabilities.

patch.name: ERNIE-4.5-VL-424B-A47B
patch.description: Post-trained vision-language MoE chat model with text, image, and video inputs, text output, and thinking and non-thinking modes.

patch.notes: The post-trained model PT suffix means PyTorch. The complete checkpoint contains 423.526285184B parameters, including the vision encoder and adapter; 424B is nominal. The published 47B active count does not define exact text/vision or embedding accounting. Novita documents this exact model available June 29, 2025; Baidu announced weights June 30. Earlier family and rolling-endpoint dates do not prove checkpoint identity. Native tool calling remains unverified; Baidu excludes the mapped endpoint from its function-call support list.

summary: Verified the exact post-trained PyTorch variant. Corrected the complete checkpoint count to 423.526285184B, Apache-2.0 license, 131072 context, video input and neutral description. Retained nominal 47B active with modality/accounting caveats. Parent added exact-name Novita June 29 hosted availability before the June 30 weight announcement. Native tool support remains unverified.
